relationships.subject: huc-MSCs-derived exosomes
relationships.evidence_quote: huc-MSCs-derived exosomes alleviated the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome and GSDMD-induced pyroptosis in LPS and ATP-treated BV2 cells

relationships.subject: miR-146a-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression levels of TRAF6, NLRP3, ASC, caspase1-p20 and GSDMD-N were reduced in miR-146a-5p mimic Exos group

relationships.subject: TRAF6
relationships.evidence_quote: TRAF6 aggravated the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome and GSDMD-induced pyroptosis, and played a negative role in autophagy

relationships.subject: autophagy
relationships.evidence_quote: huc-MSCs-derived exosomes inhibited pyroptosis by promoting autophagy in LPS and ATP-treated BV2 cells

relationships.subject: huc-MSCs-derived exosomes
relationships.evidence_quote: huc-MSCs-derived exosomes alleviated mechanical allodynia or thermal hyperalgesia in CFA-induced inflammatory pain

key_findings: Huc-MSC exosomes transfer miR-146a-5p to target TRAF6, boosting autophagy and suppressing NLRP3/GSDMD microglial pyroptosis.
Exosomes relieved CFA-induced inflammatory pain in mice.
